selectionRule: One lexicographically first (source, start, end) representative per retained spanSHA256; preserve all aliases. Digest equality is inherited metadata, not fresh source verification.
gate: Requires separate allocation/authority/runtime/evaluator review. Verify representative bytes against pinned digest; never replace a mismatch with an alias automatically. Preserve all provenance and distinct digest revisions. Does not validate bytes at unread alias locations.
